subject: spanish
title: School Subjects Foundations
welcome_lead: Learn the names of school subjects you study in a Spanish-speaking school.
meta_desc: GCSE Spanish foundations adventure on school subjects.
final_note: ¡Bien! You can now name all your asignaturas.

walkthroughs.body_html: Subject nouns need their article: las matemáticas (plural), la historia (fem. sing.), el inglés (masc. sing.). Languages and most -o subjects are masculine; most -a subjects are feminine. Exception: el arte is masculine despite ending in -e.
The sciences: la física (physics), la química (chemistry), la biología (biology). Sport is el deporte or la educación física (PE). Note the accents on física and química!
Use estudiar (to study): Estudio inglés y matemáticas (I study English and maths). After estudiar, the article is often dropped: Estudio historia, NOT 'Estudio la historia' in everyday speech.

numericals.q: How many sciences are listed: física, química, biología?

free_texts.q: Write the Spanish for 'Spanish' (the subject) including the article (no accents).
